title.zh: Wall Street gets five years to test U.S. stocks on blockchain, with the SEC's blessing - CoinDesk
title.en: Wall Street gets five years to test U.S. stocks on blockchain, with the SEC's blessing - CoinDesk

current_state.zh: The SEC has approved a five-year pilot program allowing Wall Street firms to test trading U.S. stocks on blockchain infrastructure, a major step toward mainstream tokenization of traditional securities.
current_state.en: The SEC has approved a five-year pilot program allowing Wall Street firms to test trading U.S. stocks on blockchain infrastructure, a major step toward mainstream tokenization of traditional securities.
